row.evidence: ActiveCampaign lists Single Sign-On (SSO) only on Enterprise and its SSO guide says ActiveCampaign does user provisioning during the initial SSO login; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or API reference.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM on any plan. Enterprise (from $145/mo billed annually at 1,000 contacts, 5 users) adds SAML SSO with JIT user creation into a designated 'SSO Users' group, but no automated deprovisioning. Pricing is contact-based (Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 per month billed annually at 1,000 contacts), so per-user fields stay null; June recorded Starter $15/mo at 500 contacts; the pricing slider now starts at 1,000 contacts and shows Starter at $15/mo. The v3 REST API (all plans) can list, create, update and delete users, but no IdP catalogue app uses it for provisioning. Okta's catalogue app is SWA only; Entra, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud need a custom SAML app.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: Starts at $15/mo billed annually (1,000 contacts, 1 user)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Prices are the slider default at 1,000 email contacts; they rise with contact count. The comparison table marks SSO for Enterprise only and API & webhooks for all four plans (read from the page markup).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere; SAML JIT is the only automated provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5), not an explicit vendor statement.

auth.notes: Api-Token header; each user has their own key, and there is no account-default key.

capabilities.notes: Users are created with a password and a permission group (role); there is no invite flow and no documented deactivate state, only delete.

endpoints.purpose: Create a user (username, email, names, group, password required)

rate_limits.text: 5 requests per second per account; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

limitations.text: Deleting a user breaks integrations that use that user's API key, since there is no account-default key.

okta.notes: OIN 'Active Campaign' app (last updated Aug. 2019) marks only SWA (read from page markup). ActiveCampaign's own guide uses a custom Okta SAML app instead.

entra.notes: Vendor guide creates a non-gallery Entra enterprise app for SAML.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per vendor guide.

onelogin.notes: SAML Custom Connector (Advanced) per vendor guide; OneLogin catalogue not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Custom SAML Application per vendor guide (jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-activecampaign returned 403).
